kills: answering a Ship round reveals the Ship recommendation on demand and tags the Ship pressed after it seen

mutations.name: the Ship press sends only the first side answer
kills: answering a Ship round with side questions sends every side answer with the Ship pick in one rounds.submit, in the round's question order

mutations.name: a Send back note goes out untrimmed
kills: answering a Ship round sends Send back as the other option, with the owner's note as its comment and no head sha

frame feedback on a Ship round (TP-3773 S6b) ships with a Chosen frame that has no comment, and sends the verdict

mutations.name: pressing an Addressed tick never ticks it
kills: Ship while feedback is open (TP-3741) shows round 1's Don't ship and note, and keeps Ship off until it is ticked Addressed
frame feedback on a Ship round (TP-3773 S6b) lists an earlier round's frame feedback and holds Ship until it is ticked Addressed
an unsent Ship round's draft (TP-3870) restores the side answer and comment, the Addressed tick and the Send back note after a remount
